# Design for failure

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Design for failure
- What: Assume outside services will fail, and decide in advance what the app does when they do.
- Applies when: the app depends on outside services.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: practice

### Bulkheads
- What: Keep parts of the system apart so one failing part cannot sink the rest.
- Applies when: one failing part could take down the rest.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### Redundancy
- What: Run spare copies so one machine failing does not take the app down.
- Applies when: downtime has become costly.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### Error budgets
- What: Agree how much downtime is acceptable, and slow new features when it is used up.
- Applies when: a team must balance new features against stability.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: practice

### Chaos testing
- What: Break parts of the system on purpose to prove it recovers.
- Applies when: the app runs on several machines.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: practice
